syllabus_topics: Water management and its relevant legislation.
Workshops about water management in industry and the environment.
Definition and classification of solid wastes.
Hierarchies in waste management. Legislation and waste management plans.
Technologies for the treatment of solid wastes.
Dynamics in the atmosphere and dispersion of pollutants.
Technologies for the control of atmospheric pollutants.
teaching_methods: Theoretical classes (professors teach theory, present case studies, and solve problems)
Workshops (students solve problems about water and waste management, environmental pollutants, solid waste treatment, and environmental assessment)
assessment_rules: Ordinary assessment is based on a final exam (85%) and continuous assessment through practical exercises (15%). For the extraordinary resit, students can choose between the final exam counting for 100% of the grade, or the final exam counting for 85% and the continuous assessment for 15% (if the scores obtained in continuous assessment are retained).
